scene: Following the pipes through the archway, you reach a bustling transit hub.
picture: Side view along a tiled platform. On the far left, a glass pneumatic tube pod sits open. Centre-left, the player stands holding her sketchbook. In the centre, an iridescent spherical bubble lift bobs beside a metal gangway. On the far right, a yellow tram covered in bright rainbow paint splatters waits with doors open.
